violations.why: The ISR can preempt the task's read-modify-write of *ptr_var (which is v_amber) and set it to 0. The task then writes back the stale value plus 1, so the ISR's update is lost.
The ISR can write 0 after the task stores rand() and before the task reads v_amber at line 23. The task then reads 0 instead of the value it wrote.
